motivation: The official ForecastEx /data page currently displays archive dates only through 2026-07-17 while W4-B executes on 2026-08-13. Treating the latest displayed UI date as the terminal archive date could create survivorship/access-page truncation if valid official files exist for later dates but are not listed by the UI.
old_end_date_rule: latest date displayed by the official /data page at execution time
authoritative_end_date_rule: UTC execution date minus one calendar day
enumeration_rule: Probe the official summary download endpoint for every UTC calendar date from 2024-01-01 through D-1. HTTP 200 valid CSV means archive date exists; HTTP 404 is an explicitly accounted no-file date; any other unresolved response fails materialization.
prices_rule: Fetch and hash the prices CSV only for every summary-existing date; missing/unresolved corresponding prices remains a materialization failure.
why_d_minus_1: Avoid treating an intraday/current-day file that may still be refreshing as a required completed daily archive file.
unchanged: price volume open-interest settlement fields forbidden to vote
ForecastEx counts remain census capacity not N_final_backtestable
governance: This is a pre-result recall repair motivated solely by observable archive-page truncation. It cannot be revised again in response to ForecastEx event counts.
